title: Fishing With Salty

services.name: Meet Fishing
services.desc: I went Scouting with my buddy Chris, together we discovered a new adventure one that I plan to experience more often! Catching Snook and Trout beach fishing Florida from an Island! I think this would give Anglers, Fishermen, and Fly Fisherman alike to experience a secluded trip much like being in the Caribbean at a fraction of the price! You can book your trip with me to experience a trip just like this on my New Website www.FishingWithSalty.com we caught a number of species including Snook, Trout, Ladyfish and we saw plenty Redfish on this trip as well. I offer both: Private Charters and Shared Split Trips both for a fantastic time on the
